sources.note: Accepted: 4 pieces (3 cuts), kind note; single-language; 4 in a row the source stores in this language only; lengths 121/306/283/253; a section label opens the passage in the same row, as in the base corpus. Wording, diacritics, protected markers and repetition are unchanged.

layout.note: All 1 sources are placed once, in order: 4 output rows, 0 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together.
